answer: Use 58 slots (partitions/consumers), each running at about 70% of capacity. Per the lesson's sizing rule, slots = peak / (per-worker rate x target fraction) = 100,000 / (2,500 x 0.7) = 57.1, rounded up to 58. The 0.7 fraction leaves headroom for losing a worker and draining backlog. Note that with 58 slots, losing one leaves 57 x 1,750 = 99,750/s, slightly below peak, so a strict no-lag check would need about 59 slots.
